public_contract.capabilities: Optional ShaderCapabilityProvider plus ShaderFactory.querySupport extension; no ShaderFactory, ShaderSession, ImageProcessor or modifier signature changes
public_contract.reports: SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNKNOWN; stable enum reason, display message, optional minimum requirement
public_contract.query_limits: Known effect structure and supplied input requirements only; never read source, compile, populate caches, allocate graphics resources, or call uniform/frame/live providers; missing custom requirements, shader validity and allocation remain unchecked
public_contract.third_party: Without optional provider, UNKNOWN independently of isSupported; existing explicit factory fixture unchanged. Opt-in wrapper delegates render/session metadata but conservatively reports export UNKNOWN because Skia processor requires concrete built-in factory.
public_contract.fallback: Static createRenderEffectWithFallback returns ShaderRenderOutcome(result,fallbackUsed,cause). Default PreserveContent returns successful null on requested failure; Fail propagates original error; Substitute attempts one complete replacement. Failed substitute retains original cause and separate result error. No chain child dropped; no automatic clock/session in helper.
public_contract.sealed_compatibility: No new ShaderError/ShaderResult subtype. ShaderFallbackPolicy is a new sealed type; future additions would need source compatibility review.
public_contract.compose: Existing initial-creation failure preserves content; transient refresh failure retains previous successful filter. Existing API signatures/defaults unchanged.
